en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a riverside row of multi‑storey houses at the foot of a steep, wooded hill. On the hillside is a funicular railway leading up to a large fortress complex on the summit. The word "Seil‑Bahn" appears on the side of a building beside the lower station. At the bottom margin is a printed caption identifying the location, with additional handwritten German text across the image and margins.
